data.description: When a ship picks up a new firing weapon this should add its effects to the existing weapons active on the ship. They should be active for 10 seconds and then stop working. The ship will always have the initial weapon, that one never times out.
data.title: Make weapons both cumalative and time out

data.author: Map
data.comment:
## Clarifying Questions for Intake

**Question 1 — Weapon stacking model:**
When the player picks up Spread (while already having the cannon), does the ship fire *both* the cannon and spread patterns simultaneously? And if then picking up Dual, does it fire cannon + spread + dual? Or does the new weapon only fire its own pattern (cannon + spread, but spread doesn't replace cannon)?

**Question 2 — Timeout granularity:**
Does each weapon power-up get its *own independent* 10-second timer (e.g. picking up Spread at t=0 means it expires at t=10, then picking up Dual at t=5 means it expires at t=15), or does picking up any weapon reset *all* active weapon timers to 10 seconds?

**Question 3 — Reset power-up behavior:**
With cumulative weapons, what does the Reset power-up do?
- Option A: Clear *all* timed weapons, leaving only the permanent cannon.
- Option B: Clear only the *currently active* timed weapons but keep previously collected ones.
- Option C: Something else?

Please confirm which interpretation is correct (or provide your own).
